blocks.text: за- — starting to do the action
«начать выполнять соответствующее действие» is how the Russian Wiktionary puts this meaning of за-. Its examples: застучать, зааплодировать, забастовать, забелеть, забегать, задуть.

head: Word
Made of (Wiktionary's etymology)
Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to begin to knock, to rap, etc.

blocks.text: (used with verbs) to begin doing (describing an action of commencing) — за- + говори́ть (“to speak”) → заговори́ть (“to begin to speak”)

head: Word

Meaning (Wiktionary)
rows: to begin to speak; to talk someone's ear off (tire someone out by one's talk)

blocks.text: по- — the beginning of a movement
The Russian Wiktionary's examples for this meaning of по-: поехать, поползти.
